Two options

Which one fits your week?

Per diem

Shift by shift. You tell us when you are available, and facilities book the shifts they need. Ideal alongside school, family or another role.

Local contract

A set schedule for a set number of weeks at a facility within commuting distance. The stability of a contract without the move.

Questions, answered

Frequently asked questions

All FAQsContact us
Is there a minimum number of shifts?

It varies by facility. Some ask for a minimum each month to stay active. Your recruiter tells you before you sign up.

How far ahead are shifts booked?

Anywhere from weeks ahead to the same day. You choose what you accept.

Do local contracts pay the same as travel contracts?

The packages are structured differently, because local contracts do not include travel-related stipends. The posting shows the rate so you can compare directly.
